args.title: Use appropriate public URL for password reset email links
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Replace the fallback localhost URL with a more appropriate public URL or ensure the PUBLIC_URL environment variable is set correctly. The current fallback to "http://localhost:3000" causes password reset email links to be unusable for users who receive the email, as the link points to a non-functional local server address.
